One PDF, 12.86 MB, listing has the 3 steps and Start here step 1 repeats them, but the last photo only says 'Download on Etsy in a web browser': no Open in Goodnotes step, no 3-step sequence.

coverage.where: w01, hs12, rail on every page
coverage.note: Tabs, year dates, month-to-weeks, week-to-days, day arrows and Month / Week trails all work, but Week 1 (Dec 28 to Jan 3, Thursday Dec 31, 2026) is built under January 2027, not under December as the Thursday rule (r008) requires.

Every photo is a real page screenshot captioned with its page name; description gives counts per page type and states dark only, landscape, Monday weeks, Oct 26 2026 to Dec 31 2027, no stickers, handwrite/text tool, English only.
3 jump buttons (month, year, Contents), pen test box, four-line 'Nothing happened?' list; all 12,852 link annotations resolve and all 532 pages are reachable from the cover.

Fix list and Start here are present, but the listing has no FAQ of the top five problems, and both the listing ('we'll help you set it up') and the Setup check page ('we will help') promise service, breaking r007.
Real day and week pages shown and the description lists what is not inside (no light version, no budget, meal or fitness); pages are whole and shrunk, so hour labels are small (see visual).
14 months, one page per day, roomy day and week pages, but no photo shows the day page at real size: photo 2 shows the whole page shrunk to about 60% of the canvas width.
Background #1B1F2B, text #EEEAF4, amber accents, built dark; Start here step 3 says to pick white, pale gray or a light pen color.
Top 3, Work, Home left; Time blocks 6am-10pm and Tomorrow right; week has This week's focus, Wins, Next week.
Buttons to a month (m01), the year and Contents, pen test lines and a 4-item fix list.

Navy, light ink, amber, landscape, two families, italic Baskerville labels, no tracked caps. Out-of-month dates (#676878, about 3.2:1) and week-notes dots sit below the 7:1 aim (decorative/inactive, see visual).

visual.issue: Fix list line 4 promises service: 'Still stuck? Message us on Etsy and we will help' (r007). Built into the file buyers keep and repeated in listing photo 6. Replace it with a buyer action, e.g. re-download in a web browser and re-import.
Listing Help section promises service: 'Message us on Etsy and we'll help you set it up' (r007), and the FAQ with the top five problems the brief asked for is missing.

Empty-looking Contents page: about a third of the page is blank between the month buttons and 'How the links work', and the card grid has an empty eighth slot (r006). This is also the hero screen in the 'What you get' photo and in photo 7.

Start here step 4 says 'Tap this month below', but the jump grid starts at November 2026. A buyer on Oct 26 to 31 (today's selling window) has no October button and has to guess that November 2026 holds their week.
Photo 7 shrinks two whole pages side by side. The year-at-a-glance dates and the Contents text cannot be read at Etsy zoom (r013), and a large empty band sits under the headline.

Photos 2 to 6, 8 and 9 each show a whole page shrunk to about 60% of the canvas, not the useful part large (r013). Hour labels, fix-list and tip text are small, and the bottom fifth of each canvas is empty.
A stray 160x6px amber strip floats at the top edge, left of the rail, on only the cover, Contents and Start here pages. It looks like a cut-off element and is visible in photos 1, 5, 7 and 9.
Setup check eyebrow repeats the title ('Setup check / Setup check'), and the left column leaves about a quarter of the page empty under the fix list.
Week 1 (Dec 28 to Jan 3) is filed under January although its Thursday is Dec 31 (r008). Week 1 has no back arrow to the Dec 21 head start week, and that week's next arrow goes to January, not Week 1.
Week numbers are offset from ISO weeks (Week 1 = Dec 28 to Jan 3, ISO week 1 = Jan 4 to 10). Buyers matching work calendars will be one off all year.
The same Nov and Dec rail tabs jump to the 2026 head start months on head start pages but to Nov and Dec 2027 everywhere else.
